2026-11-13.name: Friday the 13th
2026-11-13.title: Friday the Thirteenth
2026-11-13.blurb: Nobody at the Halloway believes in curses. Tonight, somebody should have.
2026-11-13.motive: the museum's most cursed piece was about to be exposed as an insurance fraud

2026-11-26.name: Thanksgiving
2026-11-26.title: Grace Before Murder
2026-11-26.blurb: The whole family is home for the feast, and somebody will not be giving thanks.
2026-11-26.motive: the family recipe had been stolen, along with the family fortune

2026-12-24.name: Christmas Eve
2026-12-24.title: Not a Creature Was Stirring
2026-12-24.blurb: The stockings are hung, the house is asleep, and one guest has made a very naughty list.
2026-12-24.motive: a gift under the tree held a letter nobody was meant to read

2026-12-25.name: Christmas Day
2026-12-25.title: Murder Under the Mistletoe
2026-12-25.blurb: Snow on the peaks, carols by the fire and one gift that nobody wanted to unwrap.
2026-12-25.motive: a Christmas card from twenty years ago had finally been answered

2026-12-31.name: New Year's Eve
2026-12-31.title: The Stroke of Midnight
2026-12-31.blurb: Champagne on ice, the band counting down, and a toast that one passenger will never finish.
2026-12-31.motive: a debt fell due at midnight on the last day of the year

2027-01-01.name: New Year's Day
2027-01-01.title: New Year, Old Grudges
2027-01-01.blurb: Resolutions were made last night. One of them has already been carried out.
2027-01-01.motive: an old grudge was not going to be allowed into the new year

2027-02-06.name: Lunar New Year
2027-02-06.title: Year of the Scapegoat
2027-02-06.blurb: Everyone is heading home for the reunion dinner. One passenger will never arrive.
2027-02-06.motive: a family debt must be settled before the new year, and this one had waited long enough

2027-02-14.name: Valentine's Day
2027-02-14.title: Love on the Rocks
2027-02-14.blurb: A dozen roses, a table for two and a love letter that was never meant to be opened.
2027-02-14.motive: a valentine had reached the wrong person, twenty years too late

2027-02-20.name: Lantern Festival
2027-02-20.title: The Lantern Riddle
2027-02-20.blurb: A paper lantern in every window, a riddle on every lantern, and one answer worth killing for.
2027-02-20.motive: the answer to the last riddle named the person who had stolen the family fortune

2027-03-15.name: The Ides of March
2027-03-15.title: Beware the Ides
2027-03-15.blurb: The company is playing Julius Caesar tonight, and someone has taken the script far too seriously.
2027-03-15.motive: an old friend had been promised the lead, and had read enough Shakespeare to know what to do

2027-03-17.name: St Patrick's Day
2027-03-17.title: The Luck of the Irish
2027-03-17.blurb: Next stop Queenstown, a shamrock in every buttonhole, and one passenger whose luck has run out.
2027-03-17.motive: a lucky charm had been won in a card game and never given back

2027-03-28.name: Easter Sunday
2027-03-28.title: A Bad Egg
2027-03-28.blurb: The children are hunting for painted eggs among the ferns. They are about to find something else.
2027-03-28.motive: the egg hunt had turned up something buried long ago

2027-04-01.name: April Fools' Day
2027-04-01.title: No Laughing Matter
2027-04-01.blurb: The pranks started at breakfast. By curtain-up, one of them had gone much too far.
2027-04-01.motive: a practical joke years ago had ended a career, and this was the punchline

2027-05-09.name: Mother's Day
2027-05-09.title: Mother Knows Best
2027-05-09.blurb: Breakfast on a tray, flowers from the children, and a will that was changed only yesterday.
2027-05-09.motive: the changed will cut out every child but one
